chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Joe Glaser, and pay in Armstrong's band
summary: He earned more than the usual scale, $15 a night against $10 for trombonist George Washington.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: When you were working with Louis Armstrong did you have any contact with the people who were taking care of Louis Armstrong's business, like Joe Glaser?
Oh, he had his own valet and sometimes Joe Glaser would travel with us, just ride around for fun...
When you first joined Louis Armstrong's band, about how much money a week were you making?
More than you usually got in a band. Fifty dollars a night.
Fifteen dollars a night and the other guy got $10 a night.
He would pay musicians different things because different people were more important.
That's exactly right. The trombone player he got $10 and I got $15 and when he gave it to me, he got mad. That was George Washington.
